node: Transmission hardware, line fittings, conductor accessories, and installation-specific components
summary: Layer 1B expands the public-company universe around transmission hardware and installation-compatible line components. The direct underfollowed name is Preformed Line Products, which appears closest to the node as a supplier of formed wire, pole-line hardware, transmission/substation products and related utility infrastructure products. Hubbell is the diversified public benchmark through Utility Solutions and transmission/substation exposure. MYR Group and Quanta Services are not hardware suppliers, but they are direct construction-channel demand anchors whose transmission project growth can validate hardware order timing. The alpha-research lane should focus on whether PLPC has true utility-approved switching costs, robotic/labor-saving installation differentiation, and order visibility ahead of EPC field activity; the reference lane should monitor Hubbell, MYRG and PWR as demand-context comparables rather than pure hardware substitutes.
